items.text: OUT-001 identifies the v3.0.1 baseline and actual candidate, accounts for every REQ-001 core-loop element, and links applicable V4-EXM-10/11 observations and outcome standing; any missing evidence prevents claiming that the core-loop obligation is met. Verified by VER-001. [SOW-111; S1, S2, S4, S5]

verification.text: Inspect the core-loop comparison against the App qualification dossier and named v3.0.1 reference. Trace each REQ-001 element to the relevant candidate's V4-EXM-10/11 observations, including reviewed workflow registration/reuse, grant/deny and interruption/restart outcomes. Reject a conclusion of at-least-v3.0.1 coverage when any required element lacks applicable evidence. [S1, S2, S4, S5]

items.text: OUT-002 establishes the actual candidate-specific live local-model request-to-human-acceptance path under REQ-002 from the joined evidence, or explicitly reports it incomplete; operation success, a receipt or a separate component pass alone cannot satisfy human acceptance or the journey. Verified by VER-002. [SOW-112; S1–S6]

verification.text: Inspect the live local host dossier and trace the original request/basis to proposed/reviewed content, the actual person's acceptance and recorded outcomes/receipts on the named candidate. Check local model/server identity and joined execution evidence. Check that source-only traces, independent component passes, stale/unknown outcomes or operation receipts without a human act cannot pass the required journey. Faithful recording of an actually evidenced person's acceptance is valid when actor and recorder are distinguished; it does not imply approval or reliance. [S1–S6]

items.text: The decision package carries REQ-003's candidate/configuration/date and result standing for both obligations, relevant practitioner-validation standing and remaining uncovered claims; historical, source-only, partial and changed-candidate evidence cannot silently pass either obligation or wider qualification. Verified by VER-003. [SOW-111, SOW-112, SOW-113; S3–S5, S10]

verification.text: Reconcile candidate/configuration/date and source identities across the two accounts and the decision package. Inspect any candidate changes for affected-evidence applicability. Examine negative cases consisting of a historical pass, initialized contract, Git merge, source inspection and isolated first-host success presented as broader fulfillment; require the supported limited claim and explicit remaining scope. Inspect practitioner evidence separately and retain absent/unagreed validation standing. These are packet checks, not new product scenarios or new scope. [S3–S5, S7, S10]

items.text: OUT-003 identifies the exact owner decision subject and faithfully records a received actual owner disposition under REQ-004, separating actor from recorder; an absent decision remains pending with v3.0.1 retained, and no favorable decision is required or fabricated. Verified by VER-004. [SOW-113; S1–S5]

verification.text: Compare the decision record directly with the attributable owner's response and the exact presented candidate/evidence subject. A positive faithful-recording case must preserve an actually performed act with the human as decision-maker and coordinator/host as recorder; reject fabricated acceptance from a tool receipt, favorable result inferred from silence, or substitution of a decomposition/setup/Git approval. Check a missing, deferred or negative response remains accurately labeled and does not retire the fallback. No new human act is requested merely to run this check. [S1, S3–S5]

items.text: OUT-003 links the current continuity/obligation account, preserves distinct replacement/adoption/retirement/release/reliance standing, and carries REQ-005's open owners and points of need without adding PEC/Domains start gates or an invented validation period. Verified by VER-005. [SOW-113; S1, S3–S8]

verification.text: Compare the packet's continuity and unresolved-input statements with the received App continuity account, accepted/current open-issue rows and external boundaries. Verify the exact OI-001/016/021/024 owners and points of need, current selectors and obligations, no automatic all-project retirement/release/reliance, and no PEC/Domains readiness assertion or initial gate. Confirm any validation period comes from actual agreement. [S1, S3–S8]

items.text: The packet satisfies REQ-006's one-for-one act/owner boundary: every produced item is the coordinator's comparison, evidence linkage or decision record; excluded implementation, qualification, human judgment and separate transition acts remain with their named owners and are attributed only to actual evidence. Verified by VER-006. [SOW-111, SOW-112, SOW-113; S1, S3–S8]

verification.text: Review each excluded act in REQ-006 against CLM-001/002/003/004 and their source owners, including the difference between a host recording an act and the person performing it. Inspect the packet for delegated policy choices, unauthorized host/qualification production, professional claims or unsupported delivery/adoption assertions; return those to their actual owners while preserving valid local comparison and recording work. [S1, S3–S8]
